title: Founder Live Work Admission
objective: Convert P102 founder live handoff artifacts into governed local work-admission records for operator review without enabling unsafe execution.
safetyRules: No deploy, release, export, package creation, network calls, or provider spend.
No raw private project IDs in primary Command Center UX.
reuseRequired: existing dashboard cards, tabs, badges, route matrix, evidence/audit/activity helpers

subphases.title: Contract / Scope / Safety Baseline
subphases.narrowGoal: Define P103 founder live work admission scope, safety baseline, subphase split, expected local data shapes, validation requirements, and roadmap handoff before behavior changes.

expectedExportsSchemasDataShapes.futureEnvelope: P103.2 must define a local result envelope with schemaVersion, currentState, sourceHandoffPhase, admittedWorkCount, blockedWorkCount, workAdmissions[], approvalBoundary, nextAction, blockers, disabledReason, ownerCapability, evidenceRefs, activityLocation, costImpact, commandCenterVisible, and unsafe runtime flags false.
expectedExportsSchemasDataShapes.futureWorkAdmission: Each work admission must include admissionId, displayLabel, sourceWorkOrderLabel, proposedAgentLane, proposedOutcome, requiredEvidence[], approvalState, blockers[], disabledReason, validationCommands[], evidenceRefs[], activityLocation, costImpact, and all execution flags false.

subphases.commandCenterUxRequirements: No UI source change in P103.1. Future P103 UX must show work admission state, current state, next action, blockers, disabled reason, owner capability, evidence/activity, cost impact, and validation commands without raw JSON, raw logs, raw policy dumps, raw private IDs, demo leakage, or runnable execution controls.
subphases.themeRequirements: No theme source change in P103.1. Future UX must preserve system, dark, and light themes.
subphases.playwrightTests: No Playwright update in P103.1 because no UI files change. P103.4 must add focused route coverage.
checkerUpdates: Update check:os-phase-status to accept P103.1-P103.7 and P104.
subphases.docsRoadmap: Add P103 plan doc and platform roadmap section.
subphases.phaseStatusUpdate: P103 in progress; P103.1 complete; current P103.1; previous P102.7; next P103.2; P104 planned placeholder.
gitCommands: git commit -m "feat(nexus): define founder live work admission contract"
